triage.note: Super Micro's Form 12b-25 NT 10-K, filed 2024-08-28 for the period ended June 30, 2024 — the notification that the annual report would be LATE, not the annual report. EDGAR files it under the form type `NT 10-K`, and the document's own cover carries the words `Form 10-K` next to a checked box (`x Form 10-K ¨ Form 20-F ¨ Form 11-K ¨ Form 10-Q ¨ Form 10-D`), which is the trap: the string a form sniffer looks for is present and means the opposite of what it usually means — it names the report being DELAYED. The document also carries `PART I — REGISTRANT INFORMATION`, `PART II — RULES 12b-25(b) AND (c)` and `PART III — NARRATIVE`, so a Part-aware reader finds a plausible Part I/II/III skeleton with no Item 1-16 under it. Correct behaviour is the refusal the contract already promises: this is a 5,415-character notification, not an annual report, and emitting any item set over it would be exactly the failure `bridgecrest-2025-abs-trust` covers from the other direction (that one is legally a 10-K whose taxonomy we do not model; this one is not a 10-K at all). GPT's curated list names this pair — the NT 10-K and the eventual real 10-K — as the late-filing chronology test; the real one is held out as `evals/heldout/smci-2025-heldout.json` and this is deliberately NOT held out, because a refusal has a known answer and belongs in a suite that can be watched red. GREEN ON FIRST RUN, and this is stated rather than glossed: CLAUDE.md rule 2 asks that a new failure be watched red before it is fixed, and there was no failure here. `sniff_form` already reads this document as form `NT` and the envelope already refuses it — doc_status `unsupported`, zero items, warnings `whole_submission_fallback` + `form_type_disagreement` + `unsupported_form`, the middle one being the pipeline noticing for itself that the EDGAR form type and the document's own cover text disagree. So this case is a REGRESSION GUARD over behaviour that already worked, not the record of a defect. It earns its place because nothing else in the corpus covers a document that says `Form 10-K` on its cover and means the report it is NOT filing.
